notes.title: Ancient Archer v1.16
notes.content:
Polished graphics settings.

"Maximize" - sound option.

!New! gameplay 'PartyMode'. Play 2 to 8 players in multiplayer on a single device in OldSchool OlympicStyle (player after player) with three gameplay modes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690075/9a1370591786f66c5cfef387ec012b9d4400fa8d.png"]
